FCTR – Foreign currency translation reserve. The FCTR asises from the consolidation of the foreign owned subsidiary, Heritage Insurance Tanzania Limited and represents gains
and losses, including the differences arising as a result of translating opening shareholders’ equity using exchange rates at the end of the reporting period rather than exchange
rates at the beginning of the period, are included in a translation reserve account and reported as a separate component of equity
